endorsements.name: Oscar Arnflo
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-25645
endorsements.description: All versions of package dset are vulnerable to Prototype Pollution via 'dset/merge' mode, as the dset function checks for prototype pollution by validating if the top-level path contains __proto__, constructor or protorype. By crafting a malicious object, it is possible to bypass this check and achieve prototype pollution.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.5)

endorsements.name: Oscar Arnflo
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-4975
endorsements.description: A flaw was found in the Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security (RHACS) portal. When rendering a table view in the portal, for example, on any of the /main/configmanagement/* endpoints, the front-end generates a DOM table-element (id="pdf-table"). This information is then populated with unsanitized data using innerHTML. An attacker with some control over the data rendered can trigger a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.9)
